requirement-design.title: Design and task proposal
requirement-design.intro: Edit designs and task proposals manually. Save, publish and adopt are separate actions.
requirement-design.product_hint: Goals, scope, user stories, boundaries and product acceptance.
requirement-design.experience_hint: User flows, page states, interactions, accessibility and experience acceptance.
requirement-design.technical_hint: Architecture, modules, APIs, data, constraints and technical acceptance.
requirement-design.empty_hint: Start with product goals, then refine experience, technical design and tasks. Incomplete drafts can be saved.
requirement-design.manual: Manual design. This workspace does not invoke a model or execute tasks.
requirement-design.version_basis: Saved against requirement v{{version}}. Coverage indexes start at 1.
requirement-design.new_basis: Current requirement loaded. Content and coverage selections are retained; review changed acceptance items before saving.
requirement-design.criteria_empty: This requirement has no acceptance criteria. Update the requirement before publishing.
requirement-design.owner_hint: Select project resources; the current assignee is retained outside the loaded window.
requirement-design.orphan_dependency: Removed task {{key}}; remove the dependency or restore it
requirement-design.publish_hint: Publish the following design and complete proposal. Current acceptance for bound tasks and their dependency chain is invalidated. Existing runs and evidence are retained; no tasks are automatically cancelled, created or executed.
requirement-design.retire_hint: Retirement blocks new adoption and dispatch and invalidates current acceptance for bound tasks and their dependency chain. Existing runs and evidence are retained, with no automatic cancellation or execution. Edit and save to form a new draft.
requirement-design.review_confirm: I reviewed the fixed requirement, all design sections and the complete task proposal
requirement-design.read_only: Viewing the fixed publication. Switch to the latest revision to edit.
requirement-design.has_draft: A newer draft exists; the current publication is unchanged
requirement-design.preview_hint: These are all changes between the publication and current tasks. New or updated tasks become to-do; kept tasks retain their status; excluded tasks are archived. Updates and exclusions invalidate current acceptance. Adoption rechecks the full scope and does not start execution.
requirement-design.adopt_confirm: I reviewed create, update, keep and exclude changes and approve applying this complete plan
requirement-design.no_changes: Current tasks already match this revision. No adoption is needed.
requirement-design.excluded: Archive the task and deactivate its binding; retain history
requirement-design.discard_hint: Your changes are not saved. Continue editing, or discard them to close.
requirement-design.eligible.none: No publication; complete the design and review it
requirement-design.eligible.requirement_: Requirement changed; review it and save a new draft
requirement-design.eligible.publication_: This receipt publication has been replaced; read the current design
requirement-design.errors.content_limit: Design sections must total no more than 16,000 UTF-8 bytes. Content was not truncated.
requirement-design.errors.tasks_limit: Use at most 100 tasks and a proposal no larger than 256 KiB.
requirement-design.errors.task_key: Task keys must be valid and unique; keys are never reassigned by row number.
requirement-design.errors.task_limit: Task title, description, acceptance, dependencies or coverage exceed the contract limits.
requirement-design.errors.read: Current design could not be read. Retry the read.
requirement-design.errors.changed: The basis changed. Preview and review again; edited content is retained.
requirement-design.diagnostic.requiremen: The requirement needs at least one acceptance criterion
requirement-design.diagnostic.tasks_requ: Add at least one task proposal
requirement-design.diagnostic.criterion_: Requirement acceptance item {{index}} has no task coverage
requirement-design.use_current_basis: Reviewed; use the current requirement as the draft basis
requirement-design.pending_basis_unknown: The original source snapshot is unavailable until recovery completes. The original requirement version and operation are retained.
